summary: fal offers free generations with MiniMax H3 Max, a model that turns a prompt or an image into a 768p clip in as little as 3 seconds, supporting both text-to-video (T2V) and image-to-video (I2V). The tool runs in the browser with no sign-up required for the no-account path, and a free fal account raises the limit to 15 free videos per day. Announced by fal's Blendi (@blendibyl) on X.
claim_steps: Type a prompt (T2V) or add an image (I2V); pick aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) and length (5s/10s).
Hit Generate — no account needed for the no-signup path.
Optional: sign up for a free fal account to get up to 15 free videos per day.

social_proof.author: Blendi
social_proof.text: we're offering FREE MiniMax H3 Max generations on fal, both T2V and I2V! Try it out: https://fal.ai/tools/minimax-h3-max
